title: 5 AI Tools That Will Save You 10 Hours Every Week
angle: Most people waste 10 hours weekly on tasks AI already solved — this exposes the exact tools hiding in plain sight that top creators and execs quietly use.

scenes.voiceover: You are wasting 10 hours every single week. And these 5 AI tools will give them all back.
scenes.visual_description: Bold red countdown timer drops from top of screen — freezes at 10:00:00. Smash cut to black. White text explodes: '5 TOOLS.' Fast zoom in.
scenes.caption_overlay: You're losing 10 hours a week. Stop it.

scenes.voiceover: Tool one: Notion AI writes your meeting notes before you finish talking. Tool two: Otter AI transcribes calls in real time — instantly.
scenes.visual_description: Split screen — Notion AI auto-filling notes left, Otter.ai live transcript right. Cursor circles key outputs. Green checkmarks slam onto screen.
scenes.caption_overlay: Tool 1: Notion AI — Tool 2: Otter AI

scenes.voiceover: Tool three is the one nobody talks about. Perplexity AI replaces 2 hours of research with one question. No ads. No fluff.
scenes.visual_description: Browser opens — Google search shown cluttered with ads, then hard cut to Perplexity clean answer page. Timer graphic: '2 HRS → 4 MIN' animates in.

scenes.voiceover: Tool four: Zapier AI automates your entire inbox workflow. Tool five: Runway Gen-3 edits your videos while you sleep. Seriously.
scenes.visual_description: Fast-cut montage — Zapier dashboard showing automated email chains, then Runway video timeline editing itself. Clock graphic spinning forward. Text badge: 'RUNS 24/7'.
scenes.caption_overlay: Tool 4: Zapier AI — Tool 5: Runway Gen-3

scenes.voiceover: Stack all five and you're getting 10 hours back every week. That's 40 hours a month. What will you do with yours?
scenes.visual_description: Hours stack on screen like coins — 2+2+2+2+2 = 10. Counter animates to 40 hrs/month. Final frame: bold question mark pulses on screen.
scenes.caption_overlay: 10 hrs/week = 40 hrs/month back in your life.

scenes.voiceover: Still scrolling? That's exactly the problem. Start with tool one. Right now.
scenes.visual_description: Kognai looks directly into lens, pauses for 1 full second of silence, then points at viewer. Smash cut back to opening red countdown timer — loop complete.
scenes.caption_overlay: 👆 The answer was here the whole time.

hook_test.format_reference: X things you didn't know about Y
hook_test.viral_proof: Listicle AI tool videos using this format have repeatedly crossed 10M+ views on TikTok — notably MattVidPro and AI Explained channels with tool roundups averaging 8-15M views in 2023-2024.
hook_test.why_it_works: Numbered listicles trigger completion compulsion — viewers must see all 5. Pairing with time-saving stakes (10 hours) makes it personally urgent. Every scroll stopped = someone who wants their time back.
